<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Cleans up stale data in the specified OpenSearch snapshot repository.

This endpoint clears data no longer referenced by any existing snapshot. This operation is not supported for OpenSearch Serverless.
